repo.name: WM Keyboard Official Addons
repo.description: Example addon repository: one payload of every type — theme, layout, dictionary, snippets, stickers, icon packs, fonts and key sounds. Fork it to make your own.
repo.author: Wasi Master

addons.name: Arcade Cabinet
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A CRT arcade board: pixel-grid key textures, a slow neon hue sweep, WASD picked out in cyan, and pixel coins, stars and hearts bursting under every press. Designed around the Press Start 2P font and the Blip key sound.

addons.name: Sakura Breeze
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A light spring theme: scalloped white keys over a flowing pink sky, a blossom branch leaning across the board, drifting petal stickers and blossom emoji bursting on each press. Designed around the Caveat font and the Marimba key sound.

addons.name: Synthwave Highway
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: An animated sunset grid rolling behind slanted, translucent neon keys and a cyan glide trail. The background is a real looping GIF, and the key-preview bubble is a slanted neon key of its own, floating above the finger.

addons.name: Blockland
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A blocky sandbox look: tiled dirt letter keys, stone modifiers, a grass enter and a plank space bar under a drifting pixel-cloud sky — a real looping GIF — with a thock key sound. The E key is cut from emerald, and the key popup is a dead-square plank block with a chunky rim. On a Bengali board the keys are cut from Pixelborno, a pixel face with the conjuncts intact.

addons.name: Typewriter Noir
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Paper keys on a dark desk — round typewriter caps rimmed in metal — a red carriage-return enter, and grain in the paper. The key popup is a round cap too. Designed around the JetBrains Mono font and the Typewriter key sound.

addons.name: Deep Orbit
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A nebula photo behind translucent pill keys, a ringed planet resting on the corner of the board, a galaxy strip across the space bar and star bursts under your fingers. Key popups float free above the keys like ringed bubbles. Designed around the Droplet key sound.

addons.name: Michil
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: The Michil community's dashboard as a keyboard, in its exact palette: parchment card keys edged in brown on the site's flat cream background, a deep-green quest-button enter outlined in light green, a gold Michilcoin on the M key, a warning-gold press flash, and coins, stars and trophies bursting from every press. Designed around the Bloxat font and the Blip key sound, with Pixelborno carrying the Bengali board.

addons.name: Braille (Unicode)
addons.author: WM Keyboard
addons.description: Types Unicode braille cells (⠁⠃⠉⠙) from QWERTY key positions, with the Latin letter on long-press and shown as the corner hint. Includes the capital and number signs. For writing braille as text — it is not a six-key chorded braille input.

addons.name: ClearFlow
addons.author: ClearFlow Authors (Xiaojun Bi et al.), ported by cinnabar777
addons.description: A layout built for glide typing: letters placed so common swipe paths stay apart, with shift and delete as tall keys down the sides and space on both edges for either thumb. Public domain, designed by the ClearFlow authors; ported to WM Keyboard by cinnabar777 from FUTO Keyboard's version.

addons.name: KASROZ
addons.author: FUTO, ported by cinnabar777
addons.description: FUTO Keyboard's swipe-optimised layout, named for its second row. Same frame as ClearFlow (tall shift and delete at the sides, space on both edges) with a different letter arrangement tuned for glide accuracy. Apache-2.0, by FUTO; ported to WM Keyboard by cinnabar777.

addons.name: Vowel Vortex Clarity
addons.author: cinnabar777
addons.description: A QWERTY-like layout for glide typing that pulls the vowels A E U I O into a row of their own, with comma, !, ? and period as narrow keys between them. Numbers and symbols sit on long-press of the letters. Designed by cinnabar777; free for personal, non-commercial use (see the licence).

addons.name: Full PC (Hacker's style)
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Every key of a desktop keyboard on one screen, laid out the way Hacker's Keyboard does it: the digit row with its shifted symbols, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Meta, Esc and the arrow keys, with an Fn layer for F1 to F12, Insert, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down. Made for SSH clients, terminals and remote desktops. Hold the settings key for the symbols page, emoji, voice and the clipboard. Best in landscape or on a tablet; with the number row turned on, it becomes a row of function keys.

addons.name: Developer Dictionary
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: An exhaustive developer dictionary containing top programming terms, syntax keywords, libraries, DevOps tools, databases, and methodologies.

addons.name: Internet Slang & Urban Dictionary
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: An exhaustive internet slang dictionary covering Gen Z, Gen Alpha, brainrot, Twitch emotes, TikTok trends, AI tech slang, anime/K-Pop culture, gaming terminology, and Urban Dictionary acronyms.

addons.name: Medical & Clinical Dictionary
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: An exhaustive medical and clinical dictionary covering drug generic and chemical compound names, brand pharmaceuticals, diseases, rare syndromes, surgical procedures, diagnostic equipment, and medical terminology.

addons.name: Legal & Jurisprudence Dictionary
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: An exhaustive legal and jurisprudence dictionary covering Latin legal maxims, constitutional law, contract terminology, torts, civil procedure, criminal law, corporate law, intellectual property, and courtroom terminology.

addons.name: Texting Shortcuts
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A comprehensive collection of must-have texting shortcuts: quick conversational replies, common acronyms, and chat expansions.

addons.name: Pattern Replies
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Snippets that expand around a name or a time: type "hello John" and get a full greeting, "thanks Sarah" and get a whole thank-you letter. Uses pattern triggers, so one snippet covers every name. Each one waits on the suggestion bar for a tap, so nothing rewrites what you typed on its own.

addons.name: Pattern Formatters
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Slash commands that reshape what you just typed: /up SHOUTS, /bold wraps for Markdown, /link makes a link out of two words, /gh turns a name into a GitHub URL. Every trigger starts with a slash, so none of them fire inside ordinary writing.

addons.name: Lucide
addons.author: Lucide Icons and Contributors
addons.description: The complete keyboard icon set drawn in Lucide's 24px outline style: all 62 tools, every key glyph, the toolbar chrome and the emoji category tabs. Stroke-only and uncoloured, so it follows your theme and the per-tool accent colours. ISC licensed — see icons/LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Bootstrap Icons
addons.author: The Bootstrap Authors
addons.description: The complete keyboard icon set drawn in Bootstrap Icons style: all 62 tools, every key glyph, the toolbar chrome and the emoji category tabs. Uncoloured fill/stroke SVG icons that follow your theme and per-tool accent colours. MIT licensed — see icons/BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Boxicons
addons.author: Aniket Suvarna and Contributors
addons.description: The complete keyboard icon set drawn in Boxicons' 24px clean vector style: all 62 tools, every key glyph, the toolbar chrome and the emoji category tabs. Uncoloured and adaptive, so it follows your theme and per-tool accent colours. MIT licensed — see icons/BOXICONS-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Font Awesome
addons.author: Fonticons, Inc. and Font Awesome Contributors
addons.description: The complete keyboard icon set drawn in Font Awesome's iconic solid style: all 62 tools, every key glyph, toolbar chrome and emoji category tabs. Theme-following SVG icons. CC BY 4.0 licensed — see icons/FONTAWESOME-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Inter
addons.author: Rasmus Andersson
addons.description: A clean, highly legible variable sans-serif font family optimized for computer screens and mobile UI.

addons.name: JetBrains Mono
addons.author: JetBrains
addons.description: A monospaced font family created for developers and code editing.

addons.name: Caveat
addons.author: Pablo Impallari
addons.description: A casual and expressive handwriting script font with a natural aesthetic.

addons.name: Press Start 2P
addons.author: CodeMan38
addons.description: A retro 8-bit arcade game bitmap font inspired by 1980s computer graphics.

addons.name: WM Font
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A casual and expressive handwriting script font with Latin, Greek letters, math symbols, fractions, and blackboard bold characters.

addons.name: Bloxat
addons.author: ghoss85
addons.description: A chunky pixel display face in the classic block-game style — the Michil theme's key font. Covers upper and lower case letters and digits; punctuation falls back to the system font. Free for personal use only — see fonts/BLOXAT-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Pixelborno
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A pixel face that can actually write Bengali. Redrawn on a 20-pixel grid from Noto Sans Bengali and Inter, and it keeps Noto's shaping tables, so conjuncts, vowel signs and reph all still come out right — ক্ষ is one glyph, not three. Covers the Bengali block, both digit sets, ৳, । and Latin, so a Banglish line stays in one face. The key font for Blockland and Michil on a Bengali board.

addons.name: Noto Color Emoji
addons.author: Google
addons.description: The standard Android emoji set, current release. Newer than the copy most devices ship, so the emoji a device draws as an empty box appear properly.

addons.name: Twemoji
addons.author: Twitter, Inc and other contributors
addons.description: Twitter's emoji set as a colour font — the flat, friendly look used across the web. A COLRv0 build of Twemoji 17.0.2, so it draws in colour on Android 8 and newer and covers the whole emoji catalogue.

addons.name: OpenMoji Color
addons.author: OpenMoji
addons.description: The full-colour open-source OpenMoji set with hand-crafted illustrations, distinct outlines and vibrant palette.

addons.name: Emojitwo
addons.author: Emojitwo contributors and Ranks.com
addons.description: The open-source Emojitwo emoji set (fork of EmojiOne 2.2) as a COLRv0 colour font — flat, friendly vector emojis. The project stopped at Unicode 9, so emoji added since (and every ZWJ sequence) are drawn in your phone's own emoji font instead.

addons.name: Blobmoji
addons.author: Google LLC, C1710, David Berdik, and contributors
addons.description: Google's classic blob emojis updated for modern Unicode standard. Based on Noto Emoji and C1710's Blobmoji.

addons.name: Fluent Emoji
addons.author: Microsoft Corporation and tetunori
addons.description: Microsoft's modern, friendly 3D emoji collection as a colour font. Built as a bitmap (CBDT) face so it draws on every Android version, and slimmed to fit the 32 MB emoji-font cap.

addons.name: unDraw Everyday Moments
addons.author: Katerina Limpitsouni (unDraw)
addons.description: 40 expressive open-source vector illustrations from unDraw covering work, study, coding, space, sports, and everyday moods.

addons.name: Typewriter
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Mechanical typebar strike: a hard noise transient over a short woody thunk. CC0 — see sounds/SOUNDS-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Marimba
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Soft wooden mallet: a warm fundamental with its ringing fourth harmonic. CC0 — see sounds/SOUNDS-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Droplet
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Water drop: a fast upward pitch bend, no transient at all. CC0 — see sounds/SOUNDS-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Blip
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Retro square-wave blip with an 8-bit handheld flavour. CC0 — see sounds/SOUNDS-LICENSE.txt.

addons.name: Cipher Tool
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Caesar and Vigenere ciphers, encode and decode. The plugin the getting-started guide builds.

addons.name: UI Kitchen Sink
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Every plugin widget and event in one place, to look at and copy from.

addons.name: Todo List
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: A checklist that remembers itself. Shows how plugin storage works.

addons.name: Text Tools
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Change case, encode as base64/hex/URL, and count words.

addons.name: Magoosh GRE 1000
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: The Magoosh GRE word list, 1000 words, as a full vocabulary pack: each word with its part of speech, pronunciation in both accents, senses with examples and quotations, synonyms and antonyms, the word family, etymology and a mnemonic, plus the plainer words that make the keyboard offer it while you type. Translations into your keyboard's languages download beside it.
addons.licenseText: Definitions, pronunciations, examples and quotations are Wiktionary's (CC BY-SA 3.0, via kaikki.org), with WordNet 3.0 filling gaps. The word list names the study guide it was compiled from; only the words themselves are taken.

addons.name: Math Mode
addons.author: Wasi Master
addons.description: Type math the way you say it and get real Unicode: x^2 → x², sqrt(2) → √2, pi → π, int_0^1 → ∫₀¹. Symbol palette, fractions, Greek, calculus, sets, chemistry and LaTeX.
